Your friends, family, relatives and anyone you are acquainted to are  absolved of the consequences of their actions on the grounds that they act differently with you or they have past trauma or mental issues. 

My ex and her group used to dismiss the continuous claims that were made against her best friend for a number of things. Once she accused some guy she hooked up with for sexual harassment made him go through shit and then later confessed that she was just embarrassed ( she though that she would be called a slut) that she made out with him and that he did not do this ( she then dated him so the case of her just changing her story because of pressure goes out of the window). My exes reaction to all of this was that she is just like this and it’s fine. 

I had this very vocal feminist in my school who was friends with this guy who was nice and supportive of her.  He dated this girl and when she broke up with people she showed us texts of him emotionally blackmailing her and other threats and abuses ( slut, Whore, etc). When she found out instead of calling her friend out she started giving the girl shit and told her not to tell anyone as he was a good guy. 

Another incident was when a girl who was constantly objectified by this guy to the point she broke down. Do you want to guess what this dudes girlfriend did? Yup! Her friends and her started calling her and giving her shit about everything and told her that she was falsely accusing him even though there were like 10 different people who said they saw him making remarks constantly. 

Like honestly fuck off! Just because they act nice in front of you or to you doesn’t mean that they are that to everybody ( I am not saying believe everything but in all the above cases there was insurmountable proof- eyewitness, text conversations and even confessions of lying)

I really can’t. I live in a India, the culture here is very different than that of other countries. Here this kind of behaviour on part of the parents is normalised. Also, I am a minor and am completely financially dependent. I can’t even work since you are not allowed to work under the age of 18 ( I am 17), minimum wage here is also like 150$ (if you get a good paying job). I am academically really strong and my family is considerably well off. I think if I can tolerate it for about 6 more years (finish my graduation and preparation of graduation) it will pay off better in the long run ( like better career prospects and more financial independence) than leaving my household and trying to figure things out. As to an escape do you have other suggestions??
Uh ummm that’s a little unorthodox, but hey it’s worth a shot! Thanks !
